eyebrow: ServiceNow DevOps, Testing & Deployment · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 21 · Deployment Planning & Rollback

code:
Scoped app depends on:
  - Shared script include
  - A plugin
  - A separate parent application

Deploy app BEFORE dependency is active:
  - activation can "succeed"
  - feature fails later, first time a user triggers it
caption: Map every real dependency before your application goes in.

code:
Before committing to a deployment time, check:
  Change Calendar      -> what else is scheduled this window?
  Conflict Detection    -> does my change overlap another on the same CI?

"Build is ready" != "now is the right moment"
caption: A real maintenance window, confirmed clear — not just a green pipeline.

eyebrow: Three questions a plan must answer

steps.label: Sequencing
steps.sub: what has to already be in place, and in what order

steps.label: Timing
steps.sub: when is this safe, confirmed against the Change Calendar

steps.label: Communication
steps.sub: who needs to know beforehand, and how are they told

code:
Plan skips notification:
  - users hit the change mid-task, unannounced
  - reads as an outage, regardless of code quality

Plan includes notification:
  - affected teams know what's changing, and when
  - same deployment, no support-ticket storm
caption: Technically flawless and unannounced can still look like a failure.
